=====================
0.cruise
=====================
description: Cruise mode with pid controller tuned for cruise mode.
invariants: ['TrivialInvariant, No description']
dynamics: PIDControllerDynamics, PIDYawVelocityController

1.t2los
=====================

invariants: ['TrivialInvariant, No description']
dynamics: PIDControllerDynamics, PIDYawVelocityController
